description: GPT-5.6 Luna's loop without its checker at xhigh on fasttext (a tool for text classification and word vectors, written in C++): the build node alone, re-run in its own session with the task and the feedback "Continue." (prompts/continue.md) every round, up to 50 rounds; otherwise luna-xhigh-fasttext-v1's prompt, limits, resources, evaluation and prices, with round 1 differing from its build 1 by that feedback alone: 5 runs. Compared with luna-xhigh-fasttext-v1 through the single GPT-5.6 Sol workers of sol-xhigh-fasttext-single: both at the workers' mean model cost (bench parity) and their costs to reach the workers' mean score (bench match).

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
